paragraphs: Rav Naḥumi bar Zekharyah asked Abaye, Shabbat 127a; Eruvin 102a. In Abaye's name, Beitzah 16a,b; and Mar son of Ravina, Shabbat 136a. Keritot 15a: 'Mar son of the rabbis'—should read son of Ravina; in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas] it is not corrected—'and Rav Naḥumi bar Zekharyah interpreted.' Bava Kamma 25b has Rav Naḥman bar Zekharyah raise a contradiction before Abaye; in my opinion it should read Rav Naḥumi.
